name: hsinchu_shinchiku_1945_us_army_city_plan
sheet: AMS L991 Formosa City Plans 1:10,000, SHINCHIKU, First Edition (AMS 1), 1945; sheet N2447.5-E12054.5/3.5x5.2
projection: polyconic; use bilinear interpolation between neatline corners (accuracy ~±15 px)
formula: u=(lon-120.90833)/0.08667, v=(24.85-lat)/0.05833; x,y = bilinear(nw,ne,sw,se corners, u, v) ; THEN apply empirical correction x -= 389, y -= 70 (fitted on the East Gate rotary 迎曦門 24.8040N 120.9715E, visible at px ≈(2345,2150); sheet graticule is on the old Tokyo/Hu-Tzu-Shan datum + label-reading error). Accuracy ≈ ±50 px.

hsinchu_railway_station.how: read off the map (rail line SE of the rotary, approx.)

science_park_direction.note: off-sheet: about 1.4 km east and 3 km south of the sheet's SE corner (px 3685,2761) — point an arrow toward the lower-right edge

note: The sheet ends at 120.995E: Hsinchu Science Park (UMC, TSMC) lies ~1.6 km EAST and ~2 km SOUTH of the SE corner — OFF this sheet (the park was farmland/hills in 1945 and was founded in 1980). Use this map for 'Hsinchu' city context only; for UMC/TSMC use hsinchu_s2cloudless2016 / hsinchu_park_osm_z16. Off-sheet pixel values are extrapolated.
